```{=html}
<style>
.compare-plot img,

  width: 480px !important;

}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(echarts4r)
library(scales)

base_size = 10
plot.px = 480

dg.sc = mtcars |>
  select(wt, mpg, cyl) |>
  mutate(Cylinders = as.factor(cyl)) |>
  rename(MPG = mpg)

dg.ln = economics
```

Compare the ggplot `theme_pub` / `pub()` look to `e_theme_pub()` at `base_size = 10`. Both figures are drawn as 480×480 squares. Code is hidden; expand a chunk if you want the source.

## Scatter

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

**ggplot + `pub()`**

::: {.compare-plot}

```{r}
#| label: fig-gg-scatter
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "480px"
#| out-height: "480px"
g.sc = ggplot(dg.sc, aes(x = wt, y = MPG, color = Cylinders)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Title in Upper Lower",
    subtitle = "Optional Subtitle In Upper Lower",
    caption = "Optional caption with more info, X handle, or shameless promotion of pubtheme",
    x = "Horizontal Axis Label in Upper Lower",
    y = "Vertical Axis Label in Upper Lower"
  )
g.sc = pub(
  g.sc,
  type = "scatter",
  base_size = base_size,
  xlim = c(0, 6),
  ylim = c(0, 40)
)
g.sc
```

:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}

**echarts4r + `e_theme_pub()`**

::: {.compare-plot}

```{r}
#| label: fig-ec-scatter
dg.sc |>
  group_by(Cylinders) |>
  e_charts(wt, width = plot.px, height = plot.px) |>
  e_scatter(MPG) |>
  e_title("Title in Upper Lower", "Optional Subtitle In Upper Lower") |>
  e_x_axis(name = "Horizontal Axis Label in Upper Lower") |>
  e_y_axis(name = "Vertical Axis Label in Upper Lower") |>
  e_theme_pub(
    type = "scatter",
    base_size = base_size,
    caption = "Optional caption with more info, X handle, or shameless promotion of pubtheme",
    xlim = c(0, 6),
    ylim = c(0, 40)
  )
```

:::

:::
::::

## Line

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

**ggplot + `pub()`**

::: {.compare-plot}

```{r}
#| label: fig-gg-line
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "480px"
#| out-height: "480px"
g.ln = ggplot(dg.ln, aes(x = date, y = unemploy)) +
  geom_line(color = pubblue, linewidth = 3 * base_size / 36) +
  labs(
    title = "Title in Upper Lower",
    subtitle = "Optional Subtitle In Upper Lower",
    caption = "Optional caption with more info, X handle, or shameless promotion of pubtheme",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Unemployed (thousands)"
  )
g.ln = pub(g.ln, type = "line", base_size = base_size)
g.ln
```

:::

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}

**echarts4r + `e_theme_pub()`**

::: {.compare-plot}

```{r}
#| label: fig-ec-line
dg.ln |>
  e_charts(date, width = plot.px, height = plot.px) |>
  e_line(unemploy, legend = FALSE) |>
  e_title("Title in Upper Lower", "Optional Subtitle In Upper Lower") |>
  e_x_axis(name = "Date") |>
  e_y_axis(name = "Unemployed (thousands)") |>
  e_theme_pub(
    type = "line",
    base_size = base_size,
    caption = "Optional caption with more info, X handle, or shameless promotion of pubtheme"
  )
```
